title: workpaper
description: Structured testing workpaper record produced from completed control-test fieldwork. Carries scope, source criteria, walkthrough, evidence inspected, procedures performed, sample-level results, exception aggregation, design and operating effectiveness conclusions, issues elevated, reviewer questions, limitations, and sign-off block. Downstream consumers: qa-workpaper (full record review), risk-compliance-core/skills/issue-writeup (issues_elevated and handoff packages), internal audit reliance scoping. The workpaper does not classify exceptions; it consumes the exception register from exception-analysis via exception_register_id.

workpaper_id.description: Stable identifier per firm naming convention.

test_id.description: Foreign key into test-plan-builder output. Identifies the test plan this workpaper executes.

control_id.description: Firm control register ID for the control under test.

obligation_ids.description: Firm obligation register IDs the control addresses. May be one or more.

engagement_id.description: Optional pointer to the engagement-scope record under which this workpaper was produced.

period_start.description: First day of the period under test.

period_end.description: Last day of the period under test.

business_unit.description: Name of the business unit owning the control. Role-level, not individual-level.

jurisdiction.description: Primary jurisdiction the test addresses. Multi-jurisdiction tests should list primary here and add secondary in scope_notes.

scope_statement.description: Two to three sentences restating the test plan's scope: population, timeframe, in-scope and out-of-scope.

scope_changes_from_plan.description: Named scope changes from the test plan with pre-fieldwork sign-off references. Silent drift is a QA finding.

source_posture.description: Source posture the testing operated under.

role.description: Preparer role, not individual name. Examples: compliance-testing analyst, internal-audit senior, controls-testing pod lead.

reviewer.description: Reviewer must be a separate role from preparer. date_reviewed and sign_off_status are filled at sign-off.

role.description: Reviewer role. Examples: compliance-testing manager, internal-audit director.

qa_reviewer_placeholder.description: Placeholder for QA reviewer; filled by qa-workpaper, not here.

criteria.description: Source criteria the test was designed to evaluate.

source.description: Regulator and instrument (e.g., 'CFPB Reg C', 'NYDFS 23 NYCRR Part 500').

section.description: Section reference. Use [verify section] if unknown; do not invent.

text.description: Verbatim excerpt or paraphrase tight enough that the criterion is unambiguous.

applicability_note.description: Why this criterion applies to the population under test.

walkthrough_summary.description: Walkthrough as the design-effectiveness signal. Not the test itself.

screens_inspected.description: System-of-record names, configuration screens, report runs.

evidence_inspected.description: Every evidence item with reliance classification and reconciliation to evidence-request-builder output.

reliance_test_note.description: Completeness check, accuracy check, CUEC posture for SOC reliance, prior workpaper ID for cross-period reliance.

procedures_performed.description: Each procedure from the test plan with execution notes and procedure-level conclusion. Procedures added or substituted in fieldwork carry pre-fieldwork sign-off references.

execution_notes.description: What the preparer actually did, not what the plan said to do.

added_or_substituted.description: True if this procedure was added or substituted in fieldwork.

sign_off_reference_for_change.description: Required when added_or_substituted is true. Pre-fieldwork reviewer sign-off reference.

sample_results.description: One row per sample item. Exceptions are surfaced here; classification lives in the exception register.

evidence_reviewed.description: Evidence IDs reviewed for this sample.

procedure_outcomes.description: Object keyed by procedure_id with values 'pass' | 'exception' | 'not-applicable'.

exception_id.description: Reference into the exception register when exception_flag is true.

exception_register_id.description: Foreign key into exception-analysis output. The workpaper consumes; it does not classify.

repeat_issue_references.description: Prior issue IDs that observed exceptions are repeats of.

tolerable_deviation_rate.description: From the test plan. Format as percentage or rate, e.g., '3%' or '0% for privileged access'.

observed_deviation_rate.description: Calculated against sample size. Procedure-level breakouts allowed where the test plan set procedure-level tolerable rates.

projection_commentary.description: Whether projection from sample to population is appropriate, and why or why not.

combined.description: Optional combined conclusion when the test plan calls for one.

issues_elevated.description: Issues handed to risk-compliance-core/skills/issue-writeup. The workpaper does not draft the issue; it elevates and points.

reviewer_questions.description: Questions for the named reviewer. Each question names the decision it supports.

limitations.description: What the workpaper does not conclude on. Reviewer's protection paragraph in list form.

confidence_label.description: Reflects evidence sufficiency, sample size, source posture, and any reliance on second-hand evidence. Per references/review-gates.md.

human_review_required.description: Always true. The workpaper stops at preparer sign-off; the reviewer signs separately and QA is downstream.

review_gates.description: Named human-review gates this workpaper must clear. Drawn from references/review-gates.md.

source_trace.description: Citations supporting material claims. Every conclusion sentence ties to a procedure result that ties to an evidence item.
